rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It did not provide an actual image-based blastocyst assessment, but what it said was accurate given the limitation.
It integrated age, BMI, PCOS, FSH, oocyte maturity, sperm parameters, endometrium, lifestyle, and first-cycle status into prognosis well, though some interactions were somewhat generic.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis framework. Minor issues include speculative blastocyst yield estimates and somewhat confident probability adjustments despite absent morphology.

Most recommendations are guideline-concordant (SET, luteal support, antagonist use in PCOS), but suggesting ERA after a single failed transfer and routine hysteroscopy is not strongly guideline-based, and metformin advice is conditional but somewhat broad.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET and luteal support. Some future recommendations are less well-targeted and slightly overinclusive for a first-cycle good-prognosis patient.
